name: orchestra
description: Agent teams with a shared board, councils that weigh a question across models, and runs on your other machines, with the Orchestration settings page. Disable this extension to turn the feature off.

voltModule.label: Teams and councils
voltModule.description: Agent teams with a shared board, councils that weigh a question across models, and runs on your other machines.

required.reason: Team members and council seats are chats.
team_send and the team board reach teammates.
The team board and orchestra_status show teammates' posts.
machine_run sends work to the user's other Volt servers.
machine_run apply fetches a run's branch into a new worktree.
Members in new worktrees run the worktree's setup on the host.
